subject: [PATCH v6 07/12] mm, swap: reclaim physical slots backing cache-only vswap entries

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch addresses a memory management issue where physical slots backing cache-only vswap entries are not being reclaimed when swap space is scarce. The problem arises because the existing put-time reclaim mechanism does not reliably recover these slots, leading to wasted capacity for new allocations. To solve this, the patch introduces a new reclaim strategy that targets such slots once swap usage exceeds 50%. This approach aims to free up physical capacity by reaping redundant backing storage associated with vswap entries that have dropped out of the swap cache.
